messages:
Cory: Quick sync — we need to finalize how the console surfaces the v1->v2 deprecation grace window. Current sketch: tenant-facing badge + tooltip with expiry + a tenant-level opt-out toggle. Thoughts?
Marta: Agree on a badge. We also need telemetry: per-tenant % of requests still hitting v1, broken down by route and SDK version. How do we plan to sample?
Bryce: We already do 1% detailed traces for v1. We can bump to 5% during the grace period but that increases trace cost and CPU. Concerned about quota/ingress on tracing backend.
Amira: Tracing overhead is mostly control-plane CPU, token billing unaffected. Ops question: how long do we run the higher sample rate? Proposal: 72h at the start, then downsample to 1% for the remainder.
Sasha: UX note — the badge should read: "Grace window — expires in X days" with a prominent link to migration guide and a small inline preview: "If you stay on v1, requests will be routed to fallback model X (latency + cost delta)."
Raj: Routing policy decision: do we silently auto-fallback to v1 when v2 returns 429/5xx? Our current default is fallback to a compatible variant. For deprecation I think we should NOT auto-fallback silently — instead surface fallback events in the console and log them. Silent fallbacks cause surprise.
Elaine: From product POV: minimize customer surprises. I'd prefer a transparent fallback (visible in console + audit log) and if a tenant triggers > threshold fallbacks, trigger an account email/AM outreach.
devex-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for flag "v2-route-affinity" in us-west, 5% tenants.
Marta: For telemetry: console chart for "migration velocity" (daily % drop in v1 usage) + "affected endpoints" heatmap. Also annotate the chart when we change sample rate or start a canary.
Bryce: Implementation detail: we can store tenant exemptions (grace-exempt) in route metadata. Need to ensure cache invalidation across serving shards — TTL currently 30s; propose lowering to 5s during ramp to make console toggles near realtime.
Amira: Also remember billing copy: exemptions don't change pricing. Need final copy from finance to show on the console toggle.
Sasha: Copy suggestion for the toggle: "Temporary compatibility grace — routing unchanged. Expires in 14 days unless extended by Support. Activity is audited." Add :warning: tooltip if exemption allows bypassing safety checks.
Raj: Alerts: if v1 usage > 20% at grace midpoint, trigger automated alert to platform + AM. Also expose a per-tenant metric for fallback-rate so support can triage.
incident-bot: alert: rate-limit spike detected on v2 in eu-central — 15% increase in 429s over 2h.
Cory: Ok action items I hear: (1) bump sampling 1%->5% for first 72h (Marta + Bryce), (2) console badge + days-left + migration link (Sasha + Marta), (3) tenant exemption toggle with RBAC & audit trail (Bryce + Raj), (4) alerts at 20% threshold + AM/email playbook (Elaine + Raj), (5) no silent auto-fallback during deprec window — require explicit policy opt-in. I will draft a runbook PR and UI mock.
Marta: SGTM — I'll sketch the dashboard widgets and sample queries for the migration velocity chart.
Bryce: I'll prototype the route metadata change and reduce cache TTL to 5s for the toggle path. Will add load test to ensure it holds.
Amira: I'll coordinate billing/legal copy with finance and confirm pricing note.
Sasha: I'll produce UX copy + a small mock for the badge + exemption flow.
Elaine: Add a line in the AM playbook: "If tenant still >20% on v1 at half-life, schedule outreach and share migration checklist."
Cory: Great. I'll open a PR with the runbook + telemetry schema and tag everyone. Let's reconvene after mocks are posted. :thumbsup:
Amira: ps — link to quick mock and notes: https://docs.internal/redwood/migration-grace-mock (internal).
